title: Jungle Scene 6 — Big, Small and Groups
purpose: Comparisons, colour vocabulary and counting small groups.

sentenceModels: The tiger is orange and black.

adultSupport.focus: Use the scene for comparison and quantity questions rather than only actions.
starterPrompts: How many monkeys can you count?
Which bird has a big beak?
expansionPrompts: Compare the elephant and the frog.
Tell me a sentence with three.

visualAudit: One tiger on the right and one small frog at the bottom left.
One parrot and one toucan on branches above.
Exactly three monkeys hanging or sitting on vines.
